headline: Sensex and Nifty Enter Samvat 2083 Near Record Highs Ahead of Muhurat Trading

marketStatus.message: Today is Diwali Laxmi Pujan. NSE will conduct Muhurat Trading. Exact trading timings are notified separately by NSE.

why: Sensex surged 1,718 points to close at 81,028 while Nifty reclaimed the 25,000 mark on November 6.
Indian equities bucked a global tech rout to record their best weekly performance in 6 years.
Financial and auto sector stocks led a massive rally earlier in the week pushing indices up by over 2%.
Historical data shows Muhurat Trading sessions have an 80% positive strike rate as Samvat 2083 begins.
whatHappening: NSE will conduct the special Muhurat Trading session today for Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
Nifty 50 enters Samvat 2083 positioned comfortably above the 25,000 resistance level.
Peak XV and Y Combinator executed a stake sale worth Rs 2,457 crore in investment platform Groww.
Indian markets demonstrated strong resilient momentum heading into the festive holiday period.
summary: Indian stock markets enter Samvat 2083 on a high note with Nifty closing above 25,000 and Sensex rallying over 1,700 points. The market registered its strongest weekly gain in six years, outperforming global peers led by financial and auto stocks. NSE conducts the annual Muhurat Trading session today for Diwali Laxmi Pujan.
